item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • 発売日: 1999-04-09
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 微熱・情熱
  • 英語名: Binetsu Jounetsu

别名

  • 微熱情熱

あらすじ

Yoshio Kusunoki was drinking with an old man at the bar. He was told that a mansion not far from the town has only girls as workers and now is recruiting. The next morning that old man died of heart attack in an alley and Yoshio looked at his last words about the mansion as a testament and set off for the mansion.

item.title: Ikenie ~Kyouraku no Shinden~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cat’s Pro.
  • 発売日: 1994-06-11
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いけにえ ～享楽の神殿～
  • 英語名: Ikenie Kyouraku no Shinden

あらすじ

This short game has a rather cryptic plot. The identity of the hero is unclear: we know only that he is a young male, most probably living in our time. One day he is resting after having had sex with a girl, and is mysteriously transported into a strange temple. Without knowing what this temple is, and only presuming it must be built by the Aztecs of Yucatan, the hero must find a way out of it, and back home.

item.title: Fechi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cat’s Pro.
  • 発売日: 1994-03-18
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ふぇち
  • 英語名: Fechi

别名

  • Fetish

あらすじ

“Fechi” is a short game that doesn’t have a real plot; its entire text is a conversation between two “office ladies” (sometimes shortened in Japanese language usage to “OL”), Eri and Kazumi. They chat mostly about men, clothes, and sex. The conversation develops, until the two young women begin to get intimate with each other.

item.title: HHG Heart Heat Girls
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cat’s Pro.
  • 発売日: 1993-12-02
  • スコア: 6.87/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ＨＨＧ ハートヒートガールズ
  • 英語名: HHG Heart Heat Girls

别名

  • H.H.G. Heart Heat Girls

あらすじ

HHG is set in a futuristic world, in which humans co-exists with androids, highly advanced cybernetic organisms. However, this co-existence is anything but peaceful, since android are going rampant, and a special police force known as ACP (“Anti Criminal-cyborg Police”) is specifically assigned to deal with them. Two young and lovely police officers, Angelica and Apple, receive a S.O.S. signal from two army pilots, who were attacked by a mysterious female cyborg who called herself Patricia von Kreuzel. Upon arriving at the crime scene, the heroines find no survivors. Together with their colleague, a young detective named Keith, they must investigate and solve this case.

item.title: NOVA
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cat’s Pro.
  • 発売日: 1993-05-28
  • スコア: 6.12/10 (20 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ノ・ヴァ
  • 英語名: NOVA

别名

  • NOVA -ノ・ヴァ- 魅入られた肢体

あらすじ

The protagonist of the game awakens in the cryogenic chamber of a spaceship, unable to remember anything from his past and only vaguely recalling his name. Something strange is happening on board the ship, and it is possible that unknown creatures have found their way into it. The protagonist meets other crew members and together they try to find out what exactly is going on.

item.title: Cat's Part-1
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cat’s Pro.
  • 発売日: 1993-02-28
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Cat’s Part-1
  • 英語名: 无

别名

  • キャッツ・パート1

あらすじ

Cat’s Part 1 casts the player in the role of an unnamed protagonist, presumably young, male, and very interested in the members of the opposite sex. One fine day he meets Stella, the queen of magic world. She tells him that her duty is to sustain the balance between worlds, but now her power is fading, which means a new queen has to arrive and take her place. To find this queen, Stella tells her companion Pixie to open the gates to seven different worlds: three modern-day ones, three futuristic ones, and one “past”, and sends the hero on the quest for balance in the world… and numerous sexually fulfilling encounters with pretty girls from different dimensions.
